'''Efridge Engelhardt Efridge's SYC racing that SUCKS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Efridge Engelhardt]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18446">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18446 Efridge's SYC racing that SUCKS], DeckTech (Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt, 19 August 2001).
